items.title: Greece Plans 10% Crypto Capital Gains Tax, Down From 15% Floated in June

items.title: Samsung Wallet Taps Solana for USDC Transfers on 82M US Galaxy Devices
items.summary: Users can send USDC across borders from late October, three months after Samsung teased stablecoin support without naming a blockchain.

items.title: SEC and CFTC Crypto Rules 'Fall Short' of Clarity, Says Rep. French Hill
items.summary: The House Financial Services chairman credited the SEC and CFTC for stepping in after the Clarity Act's collapse but said only "permanent law change" can secure U.S. leadership.

items.title: Tether Signs Deal With Kazakhstan's Central Bank to Explore a Stablecoin and Tokenized Assets
items.summary: Tether, issuer of the USDT stablecoin, will help Kazakhstan's central bank study a tenge-pegged token and put real-world assets on a blockchain.

items.title: US Government Moves $103 Million in Seized Bitcoin and BNB, But Hasn't Said Why
items.summary: Government-labeled wallets sent 833.6 BTC to Coinbase Prime deposit addresses and shuffled 40,285 BNB. No sale is confirmed, but the stash behind it is the largest any government holds in Arkham's ranking.

items.title: Bitcoin Dips Below $83K as Oil Shock Rattles Markets: What Happens Next?
items.summary: Bitcoin fell sharply as oil topped $101 and the 30-year Treasury yield hit its highest since 2002. The daily chart still leans bullish. The four-hour chart disagrees.

items.title: Bitmine's Relentless Ethereum Buying Is About to End, Tom Lee Says
